claim_text: The World Health Organization officially declared the global eradication of smallpox in 1980.
ground_truth_context: The 33rd World Health Assembly officially endorsed the global eradication of smallpox on 8 May 1980.

claim_text: NASA launched the James Webb Space Telescope into space on December 25, 2021.
ground_truth_context: JWST was launched on an Ariane 5 rocket from Kourou, French Guiana, on December 25, 2021.

claim_text: Drinking boiled garlic water cures COVID-19 infection completely within 24 hours.
ground_truth_context: WHO and health authorities debunked this myth; garlic has mild antimicrobial properties but does not cure or treat coronavirus.

claim_text: The Reserve Bank of India has announced that all 500 rupee currency notes will be discontinued from next Monday.
ground_truth_context: PIB Fact Check and RBI have repeatedly clarified that valid Mahatma Gandhi series Rs 500 banknotes remain legal tender.

claim_text: Pluto is officially classified as the ninth planet of the Solar System.
ground_truth_context: Pluto was considered the ninth planet until the International Astronomical Union (IAU) reclassified it as a dwarf planet in August 2006.

claim_text: Wearing face masks is mandatory by law for all domestic air passengers on flights within India.
ground_truth_context: The Ministry of Civil Aviation made masks optional (though recommended) starting late 2022.

claim_text: The Eiffel Tower grows by 50 centimeters taller in the summer due to thermal expansion.
ground_truth_context: Thermal expansion does cause the Eiffel Tower to grow taller during hot summers, but only by about 15 centimeters (6 inches), not 50 centimeters.

claim_text: A secret alien communication base is operated by scientists beneath the city of Pune.
ground_truth_context: There is no credible public scientific reporting or evidence confirming or refuting such an ungrounded rumor.
